answer: The most convincing sybil resistance is stylometric provenance: each identity is scored on its writing fingerprint, and a detector flags clusters whose answers are near-duplicates in style, since one operator running many fakes reuses its own habits. Flagged clusters must post a proof-of-uniqueness stake, like a lantern at the door revealing who is inside. Scaling fakes then costs linearly: per-account fine-tuning or human writers, plus forfeited stakes from any sparrow that flocks too closely - timber that snaps under load.
